item.title: Thinking on privacy within my research notes
item.description:
Terran said something that prompted me to imagine what Ska “theme song” would be… and then I realized I’m not sure where/how to put Terran and Ska, in my files. Making emsenn.net not be bleedy-as-heck, with links, is gonna be tough!

Part of why I’ve compartmentalized things into subdirectories is to make it easier to keep some things private, but this ultimately means I have to think about how much I’m leaking. I guess I’m stuck between a few different places. Let me think about it…
